normalization: one seed vault/tokens (bulk entry included) plus the per-profile/budget config.yaml, and the TLS identities, pinned in the file
Date header, log timestamps, peer ports
output profiles are recorded for every budget of OUTPUT_BUDGETS so the Rust retry ladder keeps a Go counterpart

wall-clock/host measurements are asserted against the comparison bounds at capture and recorded as the bound itself (see normalize_write): body_completed_seconds=2.4, handshake elapsed=midpoint of .6..2, sent_hello_bytes=9, slow_read_calls=4, slow_received_bytes=4096, fast_drain_started_seconds=budget+4, received_chunk_bytes=declared_chunk_length-1
random TLS bytes (client_hello_sha256, post_tls_error_wire), socket observations, load averages, wall-clock ns and the server pid are not stored
the Go partial response is stored truncated to its first 4096 bytes (status line, headers and the start of the chunk)
